lenses.name: Customer
lenses.definition: Who you serve and what they need.
examples: Segmenting customers and naming their pain points
Walking the experience end to end, as the customer meets it
Deciding what the product does next, and what it will not do

lenses.name: Business
examples: Pricing the offering and picking the business model
Sizing the market, the competition, and where to play
Choosing partners and setting the metrics that define winning

lenses.name: Technology
lenses.definition: How things get built and shipped.
examples: Choosing the architecture and owning its trade-offs
Setting the operational bar: reliability, security, cost
Getting releases out the door, again and again

lenses.name: Organization
lenses.definition: The humans who build and how they work together.
examples: Hiring, growing, and calibrating the team
Designing the org: who owns what, and how decisions get made
Setting the principles the team runs on
